scalar_horner.normalized_source:
def _scalar_polynomial[
    n: Int
](coefficients: Array[Float64, n], x: Float64) -> Float64:
    var result = coefficients[n - 1]
    var i = n - 2
    while i >= 0:
        result = result * x + coefficients[i]
        i -= 1
    return result
